title: Vertiv AI Roadshow in Atlanta, GA highlights AI infrastructure imperatives for future-ready AI factories
summary: Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, today announced the next stop of its global AI Solutions Roadshow in Atlanta, Georgia, will showcase how data centers can adapt to the growing demands of artificial intelligence (AI) through key infrastructure imperatives, including advanced cooling to manage extreme thermal loads, scalable power architectures to support accelerated compute, and integrated IT systems designed for rapid deployment and reliability. The event, scheduled for October 9, 2025, targets end customers including hyperscalers, cloud, neocloud, enterprise, consulting engineering firms, contractors, and channel partners.
